title: Beyond fabrication: Misattributed numbers in papers written by AI research agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.38691v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Verifying numerical claims in research written by AI agents is an important but challenging problem. Recent benchmarks show that many agent-written papers fail integrity checks, but such verdicts, often produced by a single LLM judge, identify failure without explaining its nature, and existing checks either test a paper for internal consistency or test whether a reported value appears somewhere in an agent's output. We re-analyze all 540 released judgments from a recent public benchmark of AI research agents (nine agents, fifteen open research problems) and manually label 256 numerical claims from 18 submissions. Failures concentrate on alignment between the paper and the underlying work rather than overt cheating, and about four in five unsupported claims correspond to values in the agent's own files that come from the wrong experiment, metric, or run. translated_title: 超越凭空捏造：AI科研智能体所写论文中的错误归属数字
translated_abstract: 验证AI智能体所撰写研究中的数值声明是一个重要但具有挑战性的问题。近期的基准测试表明，许多由智能体撰写的论文无法通过完整性检查，但此类判定（通常由单个大语言模型评判者做出）只能识别失败而无法解释失败的性质，且现有的检查方法要么测试论文的内部一致性，要么测试所报告的数值是否出现在智能体输出的某处。我们重新分析了近期一个公开的AI科研智能体基准测试（九个智能体、十五个开放研究问题）的全部540个已发布判定，并人工标注了来自18份提交作品的256个数值声明。研究发现，失败主要集中在论文与底层工作之间的对齐问题上，而非明显的作弊行为，大约五分之四缺乏支持的声明对应于智能体自身文件中来自错误实验、错误指标或错误运行的数值。我们引入了一个确定性的声明-证据检查器，用于评估……
tldr: 该研究重新分析了AI科研智能体基准测试的判定结果，发现智能体所写论文中的数值错误主要并非凭空捏造，而是将近八成的无支持声明错误地归属了智能体自身文件中来自错误实验、指标或运行的数值，并提出了一种确定性的声明-证据检查器来检测此类问题。
en_tdlr: Re-analysis of an AI research agent benchmark shows that most unsupported numerical claims in agent-written papers are not fabrications but misattributed values from the agent's own files (wrong experiment, metric, or run), and the authors introduce a deterministic claim-to-evidence checker to detect such misalignment.
